answer: Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. Proof comes from opera chorus membership: productions sung with one company across years of seasons. Forging 379 of these means fabricating 379 separate authority-backed records, and each one must survive a live registry check. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the mesa signal is public, the ivory check is automatic, and 379 aliases cost 379 times what one real agent costs, with the garden trail open to all.
